html: I want to thank all of the fans who have participated in my early reader feedback program.  There’s still a little time left to sign up to get the pre-edited draft of Wormhole, but I’ll have to cut it off as soon as the contract is finalized (hopefully in the next two weeks).  The many excellent comments will help me tweak the final edit and give a better product for all the readers to follow.
